title: Anthropic financial dataset MCP connectors for Claude Code
summary: Anthropic added financial dataset connectors via MCP servers for Claude and Claude Code, providing access to over 17,000 stocks, company fundamentals and earnings reports directly inside coding workflows. The integration targets market analysis, trading strategies and balance-sheet research from the terminal.

web_findings.title: MCP Server - Financial Datasets
web_findings.snippet: MCP exposes income statements, balance sheets, cash flow, prices and news to Claude and other LLMs.
